reasons.claim: Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri and Abu Nu'aym are co-transmitters from Sufyan.
reasons.quote: أبو أحمد الزبيري، وأبو نعيم قالا حدثنا سفيان

reasons.claim: The man is named in the text, so he stands as a link before Abu Usayd, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن رجل، يقال له عطاء من أهل الشام عن أبي أسيد

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters narrate from their fathers, then al-Hasan, his father, his forefathers and Amir al-Mu'minin, who quotes the Prophet.
The chain ends at Amir al-Mu'minin; the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ

reasons.claim: Ibn Abi Mulayka tells of an encounter in which Ibn Abbas speaks, so under ruling 9 Ibn Abbas is the last link.
reasons.quote: دخلنا على ابن عباس فقال ألا تعجبون

reasons.claim: The date is not part of the name, and the chain is a single line ending at Anas.
reasons.quote: علي بن عيسى المخرمي سنة إحدى وثلاثين

reasons.claim: All three shaykhs narrate from Abd al-Razzaq, which the readers' routes give.
reasons.quote: قال ابن رافع حدثنا وقال الآخران، أخبرنا عبد الرزاق

reasons.claim: Usama is the last link, which the stored chain omits.
reasons.quote: عن عروة، أن أسامة بن زيد، أخبره

reasons.claim: A single chain ending at the Companion who tells the account.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عمرو الشيباني، عن زيد بن أرقم، قال

reasons.claim: The bare father is a relation link, and the gloss is left out.
reasons.quote: قال حدثني أبي قال، حدثني إبراهيم، - هو ابن طهمان -

reasons.claim: Al-Layth is the teacher of both shaykhs, and the chain ends at Jabir.
reasons.quote: أن الليث، حدثهم عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر

reasons.claim: Abu Salama asks and Abu Sa'id answers, so Abu Sa'id is the last link (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: قال سألت أبا سعيد الخدري فقال

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter written.
